title: Student Ambassador Registration Form
intro: For students aged 14 to 18 years. This form must be completed by, or with, a parent or lawful guardian, who verifies consent by OTP before submission.

Become the student voice of The School Expert™. Share what works for students, help us understand areas that can be improved, represent stuwdent perspectives, and take part in meaningful volunteer opportunities within the education ecosystem.

This is a voluntary student ambassador role. Student Ambassadors are recognised by The School Expert™ for their contribution and may be invited to participate in selected events, student-focused initiatives and feedback activities.

sections.title: Ambassador Recognition
sections.description: Student Ambassador recognition: Students selected for the programme will be recognised by The School Expert™ as Student Ambassadors and may receive a digital / formal recognition such as an Ambassador badge, certificate or feature, subject to the programme guidelines.

fields.help: Programme note: Student Ambassadors do not act as employees or official spokespersons of The School Expert™ unless separately authorised. They should not make commitments, promises or statements on behalf of the organisation.

sections.title: Role Boundaries, Conduct & Representation
sections.description:
The Student Ambassador role is a voluntary recognition and participation opportunity. It does not give the Student Ambassador authority to speak on behalf of, represent, bind, or make commitments for The School Expert™ unless the organisation provides separate written authorisation for a specific purpose.
Student Ambassadors must follow all role guidelines, communication guidelines, safeguarding requirements and other instructions issued by The School Expert™ from time to time.
The School Expert™ reserves the right to suspend or cancel a Student Ambassadorship where a student engages in conduct that is inconsistent with the programme guidelines, materially harms the reputation of The School Expert™, breaches applicable rules, or involves acts that may cause social disharmony.
A Student Ambassador must not use their position, name, badge, certificate, logo, social media identity or other association with The School Expert™ to organise, promote, endorse or participate in any protest, dharna, political activity, public agitation or similar activity as a Student Ambassador.
If a Student Ambassador personally participates in any protest, dharna, political activity, public agitation or other activity in their individual capacity, such participation is personal and shall not be represented as being on behalf of, endorsed by, or connected with The School Expert™. The School Expert™ shall not be held responsible or accountable for such personal participation or statements.
